items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he loved to play with Jo Jones and Walter, Freddie Green, anyway, everybody wanted to play with that rhythm section.

ctx.x: He had just written it, yeah. And he sat down and played that, gee whiz what a thrill, because he loved to play with Jo Jones and Walter, Freddie Green, anyway, everybody wanted to play with that rhythm section. And that was the first time that he had played that melody where everybody could hear it. “Prelude to a Kiss,” yes, that was the name of it. Memories like that are unforgettable. That’s the reason why I say that New York in those days—you never knew who was coming in. There was always somebody out there…
Well, you did record with Duke on that wonderful back to back…
